record.title: DfCM current frontier
record.body: Live revalidation supersedes the R58-era frontier. Observed ggen-marketplace main@aba29c44cab7577818f392878974c405f6a0a5ff contains merged R60 consumer realization factory (qualified lineage f29068caee39ad16ac7534c789d6f186e5c65cd6). Therefore the prior opportunity 'convert R58 construction/verification plans into actual consumer execution surfaces' is no longer current. Observed ggen main@ddfa602bfbab57b7ed5150f61b0acac7a41e3020. Current weakest multiplier is receipt-backed independent consumer realization breadth and causal dependency-relief attribution. Current lawful frontier: (1) assimilate independent consumer execution receipts into canonical observation graph; (2) measure request->execution->receipt->standing->dependency-relief conversion and latency; (3) measure evidence-root independence and replay/currentness; (4) expand exact consumer census; (5) expose duplicate/orphan/stale/should-have-been-generated consumer projections. Old R58 alternative remains provenance but is marked superseded by observed R60 merge.
